title: Caral community
summary: Communities in Peru’s Supe Valley built monumental platforms and sunken courts at Caral. Its architecture preserves evidence of organized ceremonial life and substantial collective work in the ancient Andes.

claims.text: Communities in Peru’s Supe Valley built monumental platforms and sunken courts at Caral. Its architecture preserves evidence of organized ceremonial life and substantial collective work in the ancient Andes.
The source’s radiocarbon-based site-development range is approximate; it is not the lifespan of a named dynasty.

Caral makes early urban history a cross-regional question. Its platforms and gathering spaces can be compared with settlements elsewhere, without assuming that the societies had contact or followed an identical path.
